_doc: tools/import_boss_frames.gd reads this (see its header and README.txt here). The sheets are made by make_frames.py here from concept/ufo_v1.png (already transparent: background.key 'alpha'), one row per animation in fixed 620 x 590 cells with the feet (the claw's bottom centre) at (305, 448) of every cell: cuts at the cells, anchors the feet, bodyHeight 342 (the dome's top to the claw's bottom, sheet px) → height texture px. body: the hull's grey (measured only for the width). parts: the hull (no cannon), the dome and the cannon (pointing right on its mount, `pivots`: its hub) as their own sprites (one cell each, the same feet). turret: the twin cannon's states (idle, charge_0/1, hot, recoil_0/1) in one row of fixed cells, pointing right round the pivot, with the geometry make_frames.py writes (turret/turret_v1.json). Re-run make_frames.py first when the concept or the frames change.
